name: Ichieda Momomi
source: She is a young girl who may seem rather useless at first glance. However, due to her passionate dedication as a hardcore pop-star chaser, there is absolutely nothing Momomi doesn't know about the inner workings of the entertainment industry, effectively making her a walking encyclopedia on idols.
translation: She is a young girl who may seem rather useless at first glance. However, due to her passionate dedication as a hardcore pop-star chaser, there is absolutely nothing Momomi doesn't know about the inner workings of the entertainment industry, effectively making her a walking encyclopedia on idols.
